text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Constitutional Court has ruled that members of parliament cannot hold both their mandates and business positions.
- Parliament debates the amendment of the Labour Law.
- The Prime Ministers of Hungary, Slovenia and Italy will meet in Budapest at the end of May.
- The Interest Coordination Council is close to an agrement on the pension reform plans.
- The government will decide on Wednesday about issues related to the building of new motorways in Hungary.
- Petre Roman, visiting head of the Romanian Senate had talks on NATO-accession and forging closer economic ties with Hungarian officials.
